warnings: op1 direct read (house 11). ACCESSIBILITY-SPECIFIC ELECTRICAL SYSTEM confirmed: bathroom emergency call button + pull cord, call reset button, corridor buzzer light, 12VDC emergency system power supply — directly implements A-16's design guidance ('สัญญาณฉุกเฉินจากห้องเตียงหรือห้องน้ำ สำหรับเรียกขอความช่วยเหลือ'). Not present in houses 08-10's electrical scope.

Only 4 electrical sheets (fewer than houses 08-10's 4, but with genuinely more symbol variety here due to the emergency-call/TV-antenna systems) — matches this house's smaller footprint needing less repetition.
